_comment: TARGET CONFIGURATION - Phase 1 Prototype, corrosion SDL.
This is the configuration the delivered build is verified against, as
required by deliverable D2. It describes the eight-cell Phase 1 station:
two six-axis arms, eight flat cells with fixed electrodes, one potentiostat
behind a relay board, and three fluid channels.
'simulate' is true because the Client-supplied equipment has not yet been
delivered. Every device therefore runs against its simulated counterpart,
which exercises the identical control paths, ordering rules, interlocks and
data handling. Setting it to false selects the real device drivers instead;
nothing else in this file changes.
Serial port names are placeholders until the equipment is on the bench.
They are read only when 'simulate' is false.
